paragraphs: Mentioned in Chullin 136a; the text there at 87b reads R' Assi of Naharbil, but Dikdukei Soferim reads R' Yosi.[^1][^2]

notes.text: קלו. and פז: give 136a and 87b under the period/colon convention, without independently checked editions. The colon is a side marker, not duplicated English sentence punctuation.

Dikdukei Soferim’s Yosi reading is attributed by Hyman, not a new collation. Naharbal/Naharbil and Yosi/Assi remain distinct supplied forms. Initial mem is read locatively, without geographic identification or silent name harmonization. All three personal title abbreviations remain R'.
